newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish business leaders see economic upturn - paper.
newsitem.headline: Finnish business leaders see economic upturn - paper.

text.p: Two thirds of top executives at Finland's largest companies believe the Finnish economy is heading for better times, business magazine Forum for Ekonomi och Teknik reported on Thursday.

"A dramatic increase in business leaders' optimism, in particular regarding the prospects for the Finnish national economy, is the most interesting finding in the survey," the magazine wrote, referring to its bi-annual survey conducted among top executives at the country's 500 biggest companies.
It said 66 percent of respondents saw better economic prospects ahead, up from around 20 percent in May.
Only one percent now expected the overall economic outlook to turn bleaker in the coming six months. In May, some 40 percent still expected a deterioration, the magazine said.
The survey was made late in October, it said.
Another survey, the quarterly industrial barometer made by the Confederation of Finnish Industry and Employers (TT), is due for release on Thursday at 1030/0830 GMT.
